messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate on inference clusters in us-west-2a (g5 pool). Severity: P1. Alert key: inference.gateway.errors.affected-zone=us-west-2a

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Noticed spike ~12:38 UTC. Rolling 5m error rate jump to ~11%. Latency also up for short requests.

maya: Seeing a bunch of TCP retransmits from instances in usw2a. MTR shows packet loss on the instance ENI path.

sam: Confirmed NLB target health for /health shows ~40% unhealthy in the g5-usw2a ASG. Other AZs look fine.

leon: Checked CloudWatch -> ENI metrics, TX drops + Rx errors on the host level. Could be network plane degradation or ENI attach throttling hitting control plane.

net-eng-julia: AWS status shows no broad region outage, but Control Plane logs indicate increased ENI attach latency in us-west-2a for a subset of racks. Filing support case now.

ops-lead-rajesh: Action plan: 1) Reduce traffic to usw2a via smart routing (enable spill to us-west-2b/c), 2) Scale up Dedicated pools in other AZs if needed, 3) Apply temporary capacity limits on user-facing routes to avoid cascading failures.

oncall-sre: Starting traffic steer now. Pushing a routing policy flip to prefer other AZs for new sessions. Applying canary to 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

support-anna: Heads-up: a few customers reporting increased timeouts for short-generation requests. CS notified top 5 customers, telling them we are investigating and steering traffic.

maya: Dumped `ss -tin` on a couple hosts: many CLOSE_WAIT and retransmits. Kernel counters for enic show queue drops.

sam: Reduced concurrency on inference gateway for affected routes (max_concurrency from 250 -> 80) to protect backends. Will monitor error rate.

incident-bot: Deploy log: route-policy flip job started by oncall-sre at 12:45 UTC.

net-eng-julia: AWS case created (Case ID: 1234567890). Support asked for pcap + instance IDs; uploading now. They advise possible ENI control plane throttling; investigating.

leon: Short-term mitigation: enabling per-request retry jitter and increasing client-side timeouts from 5s -> 8s for streaming endpoints to reduce immediate client errors.

ops-lead-rajesh: Can we proactively spin up extra g5 in us-west-2b and set routing weight higher? Cost is fine for now.

oncall-sre: Spun up 6 g5 instances in usw2b and added to pool. Weight bumped. New sessions to usw2b increased to ~70% now. Error rate in usw2a dropping but still ~3%.

support-anna: CS update: Some customers with sticky sessions might still hit affected hosts for a few minutes; recommend restarting clients or re-establishing sessions if they see repeated failures.

maya: Captured kernel logs: `eni0: TX dropped due to queue full` across multiple hosts — matches ENI queue exhaustion pattern.

sam: Running a rolling drain of the worst 5 hosts in the ASG (cordon + terminate) to force replacement on healthier racks.

net-eng-julia: AWS responded: they see ENI attach/route updates causing transient packetloss on a subset of AZ fabric. They've opened an internal remediation ticket. Their suggested mitigation is to reduce attach/scale churn and rely on cross-AZ routing.

leon: Added temporary healthcheck tweaks: increase retry count for NLB health to reduce flapping due to transient loss.

incident-bot: Note: escalation to SEvOps requested at 13:02 UTC.

ops-lead-rajesh: Decision: keep spill routing to other AZs for the next 2 hours, continue draining bad hosts, and keep customer communication line open. Raise if errors >2% region-wide.

oncall-sre: Handoff: I'm handing off to maya for next shift at 13:15 UTC. Summary: ENI queue drops causing packet loss in us-west-2a; mitigated by steering ~70% traffic to other AZs, spun up replacement g5 instances, AWS engaged. Remaining errors ~1.2%.

maya: Taking over. Will keep monitoring error rate, NLB health, and AWS case. If we see another bump, we'll enable regional fallback to dedicated capacity.

support-anna: I'll update customers with the current mitigation and ETA for full resolution (~2-4 hours pending AWS fix).

sam: After the routing flip and drains, 5xxs dropped to baseline for most routes. Keeping concurrency caps and reduced batch size for people-facing routes as a protective measure.

net-eng-julia: AWS case updated with PCAPs and instance metadata. They flagged potential fabric correction in progress; ETA unknown.

mike (observability-bot): Metric alert suppressed: inference.gateway.errors (us-west-2a) now at 1.1% (was 11%). Suppression expires in 30m.

maya: Closing loop: post-incident follow-up items: 1) Add auto-steer threshold for per-AZ ENI errors, 2) Improve host-level ENI metrics granularity, 3) Run a chaos test for ENI attach churn during autoscaling.

ops-lead-rajesh: Thanks all. I'll draft the incident report template and tag SEvOps + NetEng.

support-anna: Postmortem note: customer impact window ~12:38 UTC -> 13:05 UTC for most customers, some sticky sessions up to 13:20 UTC.

maya: Acknowledged handoff. Monitoring continues.
